utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Hello dear, how was your day?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hi Grandma! My day was pretty good, just a bit busy with schoolwork.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oh, nothing bad happened, just a lot of assignments to finish. But I'm managing!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I think it's in the sewing basket. Let me help you find it.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Hello there, I hope you're doing well. Do you need any help with the sewing?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Thank you for offering to help. I think we can manage, but it's nice to know you're here.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandpa! I'm doing well, just busy with schoolwork. I appreciate the offer though!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh dear, what's wrong? Can I help with something?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oh, nothing's wrong, Grandma. Just a bit overwhelmed with all the assignments. Thanks for asking!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm glad you think so! It's always nice to see your work appreciated.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! It really means a lot to me. I'm trying my best to keep up with everything.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Ah, I see! Thank you for explaining that to me. I'm learning new things every day.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'm glad you're learning too, Grandma! It's fun to share things with you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yes, it looks perfectly straight to me. You've done a wonderful job!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you, Grandma! I'm really happy you think so. It makes all the effort worth it.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm so proud of you for paying attention to detail. It really shows in your work.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! Your support means a lot to me.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm glad you're happy with it! Your hard work is paying off.
